name: Lucy Minseard
original_name: ルーシー・ミンシアード
source:
An elf who wishes to be a scout and Yuuki's benefactor(?). She and her black cat companion Nii-san go and collect lucky items everyday, though her luck seems to be bad which in turn creates minor problems. The reason as to why she collects them is unclear. She keeps little distance away from humans due her being unsociable, her pace of speech and behavior.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Lucy_Minseard]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
